newsitem.title: CYPRUS: Cyprus to auction up to 20 mln in 91 day t-bills.
newsitem.headline: Cyprus to auction up to 20 mln in 91 day t-bills.

text.p: The Central Bank of Cyprus will offer up to 20 million pounds in 91-day treasury bills with a January 22 issue date, it said in a statement on Thursday.
Bids, which can be competitive or non-competitive, can be made from January 20 until 9 a.m. (0700 GMT) on January 22.
Competitive bids will be accepted either in part or in whole if the price is equal or higher than that set by the central bank.
Those making non-competitive bids will pay the average price of all competitive bids submitted and accepted by the central bank.
